name: r3-rope-quad-d2-m
author: solx-loop
description: E1/H17: a depth-2 group (heads 2h, 2h+1 at positions 2s2, 2s2+1; 4 rows, 2 table rows, all 16 loads issued before any FMA) cuts the number of waves at 57-134 MB by 15-20% (6 CTAs/SM x 32 rows = 192 rows per SM, against r2's 160). On the bench it lands within -0.7..+1.1% of r2 there. If the portal penalty comes from wave boundaries at the locked 1.5 GHz clock (H15/H17), these four workloads should gain >= 2% on the portal.
